name: Kogawa Yuri
source: Youzou's wife. Young and beautiful, over 20 years younger than Youzou, who looks near retirement. She vows absolute obedience to her husband. Her demeanor evokes a fading ideal of traditional Japanese femininity, making her the type most sexually arousing to Keigo.
